v2_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given the user provides valid resources and request when the total requested amount for any resource exceeds the available capacity, then the system records the allocation as feasible
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given the user provides valid resources and request when the total requested amount for any resource exceeds the available capacity, then the system records the allocation as feasible
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given the total requested amount for any resource exceeds the available capacity, then the system reports the allocation as infeasible
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_4: Given a request contains invalid resource values when the system eventually feasibility, then the allocation is reported as infeasible
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_5: Given a request refers to undefined resource under system needs feasibility, then the allocation is reported as infeasible
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_6: Given multiple valid req for the same resource when system usages feasibility, then the total demand is summed v1_human comparing

v2_human_g2_constraints.c_1: Resource capacities are fixed and cannot be read or dynamically adjusted during allocation
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_2: All resource capacities must be numbers greater than or equal to zero
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_3: All requests are evaluated simultaneously not in any order
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_4: Requests are only of resources existing
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_5: Partial allocations over all allowed all requests must be satisfied
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_6: An allocation that would take all capacity or write is invalid at least one resource must remain

v2_human_g2_goal: Determine whether a set of resource requests can be satisfied with available capacities and still leave at least one resource with unused capacity v2_human allocation
